versions.changelog:
**Initial release of article-format-lz: versatile auto-formatting for WeChat and Toutiao articles.**

- Generates high-quality HTML formats compatible with WeChat (fully inline CSS, 23 style palettes) and Toutiao (semantic HTML for ProseMirror compatibility), auto-selecting platform and style per user input or content.
- Provides a complete component set: titles, body, lists, quotes, info boxes, data cards, comparison bars, code blocks, tables, progress bars, info/key-value cards, and auto-layout for wide/long content.
- Implements strict design guidelines for readability, restrained decoration, generous spacing, and clear hierarchy; prioritizes content clarity over visual effects.
- Supports style/theme auto-matching via festival/season/topic/content keywords, with fallback user guidance if ambiguous.
- Special WeChat styling logic: 7 universal styles, 8 festival, 4 seasonal, 4 themed (with fine-tuning), details inline in SKILL.md.
- Platform and style selection are documented in detail to ensure consistent, user-friendly formatting workflows.
